title: What to Say When You Talk to Yourself

questions.q: What does Helmstetter say thoughts become before they turn into actions?
questions.why: He explains thoughts turn into electrical impulses which then become actions.

questions.q: Which level of self‑talk involves statements like "I can't do this"?
questions.why: Negative acceptance is described as the level with negating statements.

questions.q: According to the book, what must you do before replacing a pessimistic thought?
questions.why: He says you must first identify negative thoughts before finding better options.

questions.q: What is the main reason Helmstetter gives for why self‑talk matters?
questions.why: He states thoughts drive actions, so self‑talk influences outcomes.

questions.q: How does the author suggest you begin improving your life?
questions.why: He urges starting with more positive self‑talk for a better life.
